## 1.3.13 — 2026-09-16

### Rich describe that stays inside its memory, jobs that run when you press, and timelines that keep the project's shape

- **Rich describe on a Mac stays inside its memory.** The describe process
  bounds the Metal allocator from the parent's budget and releases it after
  every window; a clip that swells past the budget is killed mid-clip and
  held, not skipped, and the next clip runs one rung lighter (fewer frames
  first, a smaller model only when nothing else is left). Before loading, a
  room check names what has the memory ("DaVinci Resolve is using 14 GB")
  and loads nothing on a full machine; a held lane resumes on its own once
  the room comes back. Retry stays the manual override.
- **An explicit press runs its jobs whatever project is open.** Generate
  previews, Analyse, lane play buttons, Rescan and the catch-ups pin their
  jobs so the "keep analysing other projects" switch cannot set them aside.
  When work IS set aside for other projects, the log, a toast and the
  tray's idle line say so.
- **Rich describe windows scale with the clip.** A long roll earns more
  windows than the fixed cap; the parent's patience follows the count, so a
  legitimately long describe is not killed as a hang. Moments no longer cut
  holes inside a deliberate zoom rack, and the motion summary names the
  longest sustained move rather than calling a slow pan "static".
- **Timelines built from documents keep the project's shape.** A 2160x3840
  project no longer gets 1920x1080 timelines; a timeline whose rate and shape
  match the project stays on project settings instead of a custom copy.
- **MCP reads any project in the library.** The pool tools take a
  project_id, so an agent can read a sibling project's clips and transcripts
  without switching projects. The MCP card gains a desktop door and a New
  token button.
- **Auto-cut word pass runs on the card.** Filler-word alignment used a
  second full CPU Whisper pass beside an idle CUDA card (three minutes);
  now it runs on CUDA under the GPU lock, 30 s to 3 s measured. Resync logs
  what it is waiting on instead of a silent banner.
- **Closing the Rough Cut tool mid-transcription no longer crashes the app.**
  The worker is parked, not terminated inside a torch forward.
- **Adopt places stills again.** "Place on Timeline" refused every photo in
  a mixed project because the scan never marked them as photos.
- **Storage page shows each drive once**, named by label ("YouTube (J:)"),
  with its role, free space and Relink, and redraws when a drive is plugged
  or pulled; other drives your settings point at are listed separately.
- **A project on an away drive never writes into a "vol:" folder.** The
  Documents writer and the project catalog answer "not here" instead of
  building a broken path.
- **Opening a project stalls less.** The requeue sweep no longer writes the
  database under the click, an empty approval-expiry sweep no longer takes
  the write lock (1.6 s to 1 ms), and the media band reads files off the GUI
  thread.
- **The Discord community bot is quieter**; diagnostics bundles are handled
  by ORION alone.
